name: Melody Garden
title: How to practice piano and guitar offline on Android
description: Build a short offline piano or guitar practice routine with Melody Garden: on-screen practice, optional microphone feedback, favorites, and local progress.
answer: You can practice piano and guitar offline with Melody Garden on Android. Choose your instrument and learning age range, then use lessons and on-screen practice without microphone permission. Microphone practice and the guitar tuner are optional; sound is analyzed on your device without recording or uploading audio.

sections.heading: What an offline music learning app should let you do
paragraphs: When comparing offline piano learning apps or offline guitar lessons, check what works after installation. A lesson catalogue that opens without Wi-Fi is useful only if the practice activity you want also works. Try a lesson, repeat it, and reopen the app before relying on it during a journey or in a room with poor reception.

Melody Garden's current Android release provides offline piano and guitar learning, on-screen practice, and local lesson progress. It has no account or advertising. This guide describes that release; it does not promise a particular song library, instrument accessory, or result from a fixed amount of practice.

sections.heading: A simple ten-minute practice plan
steps: Spend the first minute choosing one instrument and a lesson appropriate to your learning age range. Keeping the session focused makes it easier to notice what needs another attempt.
Use the next three minutes for a short passage or exercise in on-screen practice. Repeat the same material instead of switching lessons each time you make a mistake.
Spend four minutes repeating the part that felt least familiar. If you want sound-based feedback and have an instrument available, try optional microphone practice. Otherwise, continue on screen.
Use the final two minutes to review your practice results and decide what to revisit. Save useful material in favorites where available, so the next session begins with a clear task.
paragraphs: This is a suggested routine, not a timed mode or guaranteed learning programme built into the app. On-screen practice can introduce notes and patterns; playing a physical instrument also involves touch, positioning, and technique that a phone screen cannot reproduce.

sections.heading: Choose on-screen or microphone practice
paragraphs: Start on screen if you do not want to grant microphone access. You can deny that permission and continue using on-screen practice. If you choose microphone practice or the guitar tuner, the app asks for permission and uses live sound for pitch feedback.

For sound-based practice, reduce competing noise and play a clear note before interpreting the feedback. A noisy room can make a pitch exercise harder to follow. The microphone feature does not create a saved audio recording and does not upload your performance.

sections.heading: Keep progress and prepare for offline use
steps: Check the Melody Garden app page for current download access; a public store listing is not guaranteed while release access is being confirmed.
Open the installed app, select your instrument, and complete a short practice activity.
Turn off your connection and repeat the activity you plan to use. This gives you a practical check on your installed version before travelling.
Keep the app's local data if you want to retain lesson progress, results, favorites, and settings. Reset progress in Settings or uninstalling removes that local information.
paragraphs: Because progress is stored locally without an account, do not assume it will synchronize to another phone. Read the app privacy policy for the current data-handling details.

faq: Can I practice without allowing the microphone?
Yes. Melody Garden supports on-screen practice without microphone permission. Microphone practice and the guitar tuner are optional.
Can children and adults use the app?
Melody Garden supports children, teens, and adults, with the selected learning age range used on the device to adapt lessons.
Is Melody Garden an offline guitar learning app as well as a piano app?
Yes. The current Android release supports both piano and guitar learning offline. Choose an instrument in the app and use its lessons and practice features.

name: Arrow unleashed
title: An offline arrow puzzle game without ads: what to check
description: Explore offline arrow puzzles with Arrow unleashed. Check ad-free play, daily puzzles, hints, local milestones, and how to keep or delete your progress.
answer: Arrow unleashed is an offline Android arrow puzzle game whose current release has no ads, accounts, or in-app purchases. It does not request internet permission. Puzzle progress, hints, remaining lives, daily puzzle completions, XP, badges, and daily goal progress are saved locally on your phone.

sections.heading: Offline play and no ads are different promises
paragraphs: Searching for an offline arrow puzzle game does not by itself tell you whether a game contains advertising or optional online services. Likewise, an ad-free game is not necessarily available without a connection. Check both details for the release you intend to install.

Arrow unleashed's current release combines offline play with no advertising SDK or network services. That makes it suitable for a puzzle break when you do not want an account or an internet connection. This describes this app specifically; it is not a claim about similarly named arrow games.

sections.heading: Check a puzzle game before relying on it offline
steps: Start with the official app page and check download access. Avoid assuming that an unrelated APK with a similar name is the same game.
Open the installed game and try a puzzle. Then turn off your connection and check that the activity you want remains available.
Close and reopen the app to check that your progress is saved. Arrow unleashed keeps gameplay records in private local app storage.
Review settings for vibration. Arrow unleashed uses optional vibration feedback, which you can turn off in the app settings.
paragraphs: This check is especially useful before a flight or commute. Downloading and installing an app through Google Play still needs a connection; offline gameplay refers to using the installed game.

sections.heading: Make daily puzzles part of a short routine
paragraphs: Pick one puzzle or daily goal for a session rather than trying to finish everything at once. Pause to look at the puzzle before spending a hint, and use the outcome to decide what to try next. This is a suggested playing habit, not a promise of unlimited hints or a solution to every level.

The app stores daily puzzle completions, completion dates, XP, badges, and daily goal progress. These records let you follow your own milestones over time. They are local records, so do not assume they represent an online leaderboard or synchronize between devices.

Searches for arrow puzzle answers can refer to many unrelated games and layouts. For useful support, identify Arrow unleashed and describe the puzzle you are playing rather than relying on a generic answer intended for another app.

sections.heading: Keep your milestones, or make a clean start
paragraphs: Restarting one puzzle does not erase all progress, settings, or milestones. If you want to continue your daily routine, keep the app storage intact. The current release has no reset-all control inside the app.

To delete all local records, clear the app's storage using Android Settings or uninstall the app. This removes the local information used to continue playing. There is no developer account or server copy of gameplay data for Wonderworld Labs to restore or delete, and the app is configured not to participate in Android app-data backup.

faq: Does Arrow unleashed require Wi-Fi to play?
No. The current Android release works offline and does not request internet permission.
Are hints unlimited?
The app saves hints and remaining lives locally. This guide does not claim that hints are unlimited; check the current game for how they work.
Does restarting a puzzle delete my badges?
Restarting a puzzle does not delete all progress, settings, or milestones. Clearing Android app storage or uninstalling removes local records.
Where do I find the official download?
Use the Arrow unleashed app page linked below to check current Google Play access or contact Wonderworld Labs. Public availability is still unconfirmed.

name: The Whispering Diary
title: Offline AI character chat on Android: setup and privacy
description: Learn how The Whispering Diary runs fictional AI conversations locally on Android after model setup, with diary lock, local memories, exports, and deletion controls.
answer: The Whispering Diary runs ordinary AI character conversations on your Android phone after a one-time model download of approximately 805 MB. You talk with Elias, an original fictional character generated by a small local model. The app is for adult entertainment, with no account or developer-operated chat server.

sections.heading: What offline AI character chat means here
paragraphs: An offline AI chat app uses a model on your device to generate responses. In The Whispering Diary, ordinary conversations do not require an internet connection after model setup. A download is still needed first, so offline conversation should not be confused with installation that never uses a network.

Elias is a fictional character, not a person or professional adviser. A small local model can produce inaccurate or inconsistent responses. Use the conversation as entertainment rather than relying on it for factual, professional, or emergency advice.

sections.heading: Prepare the app before chatting without internet
steps: Check the official Whispering Diary app page for current Android download access. Store availability is not yet confirmed for every account.
Use a connection for initial setup and allow time for the approximately 805 MB Qwen model download from Hugging Face. The app checks the downloaded file before use.
After setup completes, try an ordinary conversation. Turn off your connection and try another message to confirm offline operation on your installed version.
Consider enabling the optional diary lock if other people use your phone. It uses the device biometric or screen-lock system; the app does not receive your fingerprint or device PIN.
paragraphs: Download size is not the same as a complete storage or memory requirement. If setup does not complete, check your connection and available device storage, then contact support rather than assuming every Android phone has identical compatibility or response speed.

sections.heading: Know what stays local and what uses another service
paragraphs: Conversations, drafts, user-approved memories, preferences, and response flags are stored in app-private storage and excluded from Android automatic cloud backup. Wonderworld Labs does not receive these records or operate a chat server for them.

The initial model download is a separate network activity. Hugging Face and its delivery infrastructure may process technical request details, such as the IP address and requested file. Diary entries are not included in that download request.

Exporting a conversation is another boundary to consider. Android's document picker lets you choose a destination, and that destination may have its own storage or backup practices. Local conversation processing does not make a file exported to a cloud destination local-only.

sections.heading: Manage memories, flags, and deletion deliberately
paragraphs: The app stores user-approved memories alongside conversations. If a response is unsuitable, flagging saves a reason and optional note locally and hides the response. It does not send a report to Wonderworld Labs, so do not use a local flag as a substitute for contacting support.

Settings provides individual deletion and an erase function. Removing the downloaded model preserves conversations; it is not the same action as erasing diary data. Uninstalling removes local app data. If you exported a conversation, manage that exported copy separately at its destination.

These distinctions help you choose between freeing model storage, deleting an individual conversation, and removing diary records. Read the current policy before deciding which action matches your intent.

faq: Can I chat with Elias without internet?
Yes, ordinary conversations work offline after the initial model download and setup.
Is this an AI diary app for children?
No. The Whispering Diary is a fictional character-conversation app for adults.
Does deleting the model delete my conversations?
No. Removing the downloaded model preserves conversations. Use the app's deletion or erase controls to remove diary data.
Do I need an account or subscription?
The current release has no account, advertising SDK, analytics SDK, subscriptions, or purchases.

name: Melody Garden
title: Piano app not detecting notes? Microphone checks for Melody Garden
description: Check Android microphone permissions, room noise, and practice mode when Melody Garden pitch feedback is not responding. Continue with on-screen practice if needed.
answer: If Melody Garden microphone practice is not responding, check that you selected microphone practice, allowed microphone access, and are playing a clear sound in a quiet space. If you prefer not to use the microphone, you can deny permission and continue with on-screen practice. Clearing lesson progress is not a first troubleshooting step.

sections.heading: First, separate microphone input from on-screen practice
paragraphs: Melody Garden has on-screen practice as well as optional microphone practice and a guitar tuner. A touch exercise does not require microphone permission. Before changing phone settings, check which activity you are using and whether you actually want the app to listen to an instrument.

This guide covers basic microphone checks for the current Android release. It does not establish a hardware fault, diagnose instrument tuning, or promise compatibility with a USB or Bluetooth MIDI accessory. Instructions for a different piano app may describe connections or settings that Melody Garden does not offer.

sections.heading: Check the permission without resetting the app
steps: Open Android Settings, find Apps, and select Melody Garden. The menu names can differ between phone manufacturers.
Open Permissions and look for Microphone. If you want microphone practice, choose an available option that permits access while using the app.
Return to Melody Garden and start the microphone activity again. If Android asks for permission each time, respond to that prompt for the current session.
If you do not want to grant access, return to on-screen practice instead. You do not need to delete data or reinstall just to use the touch-based option.
paragraphs: Android permission settings control whether an app may access the microphone; changing them does not improve the quality of sound in the room. Treat permission and sound conditions as separate checks.

sections.heading: Try a clear, repeatable sound test
steps: Move away from a television, conversation, or loud background music. Place the phone so its microphone is not covered by your hand or resting against fabric.
Play a single clear note and let it settle before trying the next one. Use the same short exercise for each check so that you change one thing at a time.
If the instrument is quiet, try a more suitable phone position without placing it where it could fall or interfere with your playing.
Compare the result after each small change. If feedback remains unreliable, continue on screen and collect details for support instead of repeatedly resetting progress.
paragraphs: These are practical troubleshooting suggestions, not a claim that every missed note is caused by noise. Input quality, the selected activity, and the installed release can all matter. A successful check on one phone does not establish identical behavior on another.

sections.heading: What to include in a support request
paragraphs: Describe your phone model, Android version, app version if visible, instrument, selected practice activity, and what feedback you expected. Say whether microphone permission is allowed and whether a quieter setting changed the behavior. A short description of the steps is more useful than simply saying that the app cannot hear you.

The current app analyzes microphone sound live on the device. It does not record, save, or upload microphone audio. Lesson results and settings are local; the developer does not automatically receive diagnostic reports or a copy of your practice. Contact support through the app page and avoid including unnecessary personal information.

faq: Can I keep learning if microphone access is denied?
Yes. Use on-screen practice. Microphone access is optional for microphone practice and the guitar tuner.
Should I reset progress to fix note detection?
Reset progress removes local learning information. It is not needed for the permission and room-noise checks in this guide.
Does the app upload my instrument recording?
The current release does not record, save, or upload microphone audio; it analyzes sound live on the device.

name: Arrow unleashed
title: Arrow unleashed progress: restarting puzzles versus resetting app data
description: Understand where Arrow unleashed saves progress, what a puzzle restart keeps, and why clearing Android app storage removes daily completions and milestones.
answer: Arrow unleashed stores puzzle progress, hints, lives, daily completions, XP, badges, settings, and daily goals locally. Restarting one puzzle does not erase all those records. Clearing Android app storage or uninstalling removes local records; the current release has no developer account, cloud recovery, or in-app reset-all control.

sections.heading: Choose the action that matches your intention
paragraphs: If you only want another attempt at a puzzle, use the game’s puzzle restart rather than deleting app storage. If your intention is to remove every local record, Android storage controls or uninstalling are the relevant actions. These choices have different consequences even when both are casually described as a reset.

The current release keeps progress in private local app storage. That includes completion dates, daily puzzle completions, XP, badges, daily goals, remaining lives, hints, and preferences. Keeping the app data intact matters when you want your next session to continue from those records.

sections.heading: Before troubleshooting missing progress
steps: Confirm that you opened Arrow unleashed on the same phone where you played. A similarly named game or a separate installation is not the same local record.
Consider what changed before the progress disappeared: an uninstall, clear-storage action, device change, or ordinary puzzle restart. Write that down before making more changes.
If the app is still installed, avoid clearing its storage as an experiment. That action removes the very records you may be trying to keep.
Contact support with the app name, phone model, installed version if available, and the sequence of events. Do not assume support has a remote copy of the save.
paragraphs: This is a checklist for understanding the situation, not a guaranteed recovery procedure. The app does not upload gameplay information to Wonderworld Labs, and there is no developer-operated game server from which your records can be downloaded.

sections.heading: What Android clear storage means for this game
paragraphs: Android distinguishes temporary cache from app data. Clear storage removes an app’s data; it is not equivalent to closing and reopening the app. Labels may differ between phones, so read the confirmation on your device before choosing a deletion action.

For Arrow unleashed, the privacy policy identifies Android clear storage and uninstalling as ways to remove local gameplay records. If you deliberately want to start over, first decide whether losing milestones and settings is acceptable. The current release has no in-app reset-all control.

Do not infer that clearing cache resets your puzzle history or that it repairs every save problem. This guide does not prescribe cache clearing as a recovery method. It explains the documented deletion boundary so that a routine troubleshooting attempt does not become an accidental reset.

sections.heading: Changing phones and keeping realistic expectations
paragraphs: The app has no account and is configured not to participate in Android app-data backup. There is no documented cloud-save or cross-device synchronization feature in this release. Installing the game on another device should not be treated as a way to recover your previous local progress.

Daily completions and badges describe what is stored by your installation. They do not imply an online leaderboard or a server-side history. If keeping a record of a milestone matters to you, note it separately before removing the app, while recognizing that a note or screenshot is not an importable game save.

sections.heading: Clear cache or clear storage: check the label first
paragraphs: Android distinguishes temporary cache from stored app data. Clearing storage is a destructive reset of app data, while clearing cache removes temporary files. Names and menus vary across phones; read the confirmation dialog instead of assuming two neighbouring buttons do the same thing.

If your aim is simply to replay a puzzle, use the game’s own controls. Do not clear Android storage to troubleshoot a difficult board or obtain hints. If the game is not responding, first try closing and reopening it; keep any error text for support before taking a step that removes saves.
steps: Decide whether you want to replay one puzzle, troubleshoot an unresponsive app, or erase all local records.
For a replay, stay within the game. For a technical problem, note what happened and try reopening it.
If you choose Android storage controls, read the exact action and cancellation options before confirming.
Treat clearing storage or uninstalling as loss of local progress; do not expect an account-based restore.

faq: Does a puzzle restart delete all my XP and badges?
No. Restarting one puzzle does not delete all progress, settings, or milestones.
Can Wonderworld Labs restore my save from its server?
The current release does not upload gameplay data or maintain a developer server copy. Server recovery is therefore unavailable.
How do I intentionally remove all local records?
Use Android Settings to clear the app storage or uninstall the app. These actions remove local information; review the consequences before proceeding.

name: The Whispering Diary
title: Export or delete local AI conversations in The Whispering Diary
description: Keep a copy of a Whispering Diary conversation, choose an export destination, and understand deletion, local memories, flags, and removing the AI model.
answer: The Whispering Diary can export conversations through Android’s document picker to a destination you choose. Settings provides individual deletion and an erase function. Removing the downloaded AI model preserves conversations, and deleting diary data does not manage copies you already exported elsewhere.

sections.heading: Decide whether you want a copy, a deletion, or more space
paragraphs: An export creates a separate copy of conversation content. Deletion removes records controlled by the app. Removing a model affects the files used to generate replies. These actions solve different problems, so start with the outcome you want before selecting a control.

The Whispering Diary is a fictional character-conversation app for adults. Its ordinary chats with Elias run locally after model setup, and conversations, drafts, preferences, user-approved memories, and local flags stay in app-private storage. No developer chat server receives those records.

sections.heading: Export a conversation with a clear destination
steps: Choose the conversation you want to keep and use the app’s conversation export feature. This guide does not assume a particular menu label or file format across versions.
When Android opens its document picker, inspect the destination you are choosing. A device folder and a connected cloud-storage provider can have different backup and sharing behavior.
Complete the save, then check the chosen destination for the exported file before relying on it as your copy.
If you plan to delete the original conversation, confirm that the exported copy contains the material you intended to keep. Do not assume an export can later be imported into the app.
paragraphs: Export is a user-directed action. The destination you select may have its own retention, synchronization, or access settings. Running AI locally does not guarantee that a file you save to a cloud location will remain only on your phone.

sections.heading: Delete the intended information, not just the model
paragraphs: Settings offers individual deletion and an erase function. Read the control and its confirmation in your installed version to understand the intended scope. Conversations and user-approved memories are both kinds of stored information; do not assume that removing a single message necessarily removes every related memory.

Removing the downloaded model preserves conversations. If your goal is to erase diary records, model removal alone does not accomplish it. Conversely, do not use an erase function merely because you want to make room by removing the model.

Uninstalling removes local app data. The app’s private records are excluded from Android automatic cloud backup, so uninstalling is not a reliable way to move your conversations to a new installation. The current policy documents exports but does not promise an import or account-based recovery feature.

sections.heading: Remember exported copies and response flags
paragraphs: An export is separate from the app’s private records. If you later decide to remove that copy, manage it at the destination you selected, including any separate backup or trash controls offered there. Erasing diary data should not be treated as confirmation that an exported file elsewhere has disappeared.

Flagging a response hides it and stores your reason and optional note locally. Nothing is sent to Wonderworld Labs. Flags remain until you remove them, erase diary data, or uninstall. A flag is not a support ticket and does not alert a reviewer outside your phone.

For help, describe the operation and the difficulty through the support link on the app page. You do not need to include the private contents of a conversation to ask where an export went or how a deletion control works.

sections.heading: Check an export before removing the local diary
paragraphs: Before deleting something you want to keep, open the exported file from the destination you chose and check that it contains the conversation you expected. A saved file is a readable copy; the current app policy does not promise that you can import it to restore the diary, its memories, or its settings.

A cloud provider selected in Android’s document picker may synchronize the export beyond your phone. A local destination may still be included in another backup process. The app’s diary lock does not automatically protect a separate exported file. Choose a destination based on who can access it.

Deleting a conversation in the app does not remove copies you previously exported or shared. To remove those, visit the destination provider and check its deletion, trash, and backup controls. Avoid sending a private export to support when a short description of the problem will do.

faq: Does removing the AI model erase my diary?
No. Removing the model preserves conversations. Use the documented deletion or erase controls for diary data.
Can I export to cloud storage?
The Android document picker presents available destinations. If you choose a cloud provider, its storage and backup practices apply to that exported copy.
Will a response flag send my conversation to support?
No. Response flags and their notes are stored locally and are not sent to Wonderworld Labs.
Can I restore an export into the app?
The current policy documents conversation export, but does not promise import or restore support. Treat an export as a separate readable copy unless your installed version explicitly offers more.

name: Melody Garden
title: Learn piano: start with an online keyboard or an Android app
description: Find your first notes, practise a short pattern, and choose between a virtual piano and offline Android practice. Understand what each option can teach.
answer: To start learning piano, find a group of two black keys and the white key immediately to its left: C. Practise a short C–D–E pattern slowly before adding more notes. An online piano offers a quick browser start; an offline Android app can help you keep a practice routine without a connection. Neither replaces the feel of a physical keyboard.

sections.heading: Choose the tool for your first session
paragraphs: If you want to play piano online without installing an app, choose a browser instrument that makes sound when you tap its keys. Check whether it labels musical notes, which computer keys it maps to notes, and whether it works on your phone. A computer-keyboard letter is an input shortcut and may not be the musical note being played.

If you want lessons and practice available without a connection, Melody Garden provides piano and guitar learning on Android, including on-screen practice and local progress. Wonderworld Labs plans a web version; there is no released web player promised by this guide. Features, pricing, and a launch date for that version have not been announced.

sections.heading: Find C, then play a small pattern
paragraphs: Black keys repeat in groups of two and three. The white key just before a group of two is C. Moving right from C, the next white keys are D and E. Use that repeating shape to find another C elsewhere on a keyboard.

Try C–D–E–D–C as a simple exercise, not as a song supplied by the app. Play one note for each steady count. If a note sounds late or wrong, slow down and repeat just the transition that caused trouble.
steps: Find a group of two black keys and the C to its left.
Play C, then D, then E, with one note per count.
Return through D to C, keeping the gaps between notes even.
Repeat the pattern twice before trying it from another C.

sections.heading: Move from a pattern to a song
paragraphs: Choose a short melody from a lawful source with notes you can identify. Work on one phrase at a time and separate finding the notes from keeping time. Start slowly enough that you can repeat the phrase without guessing; then join two phrases. This is a learning approach, not a claim about a particular song catalogue in Melody Garden.

On a physical piano, hand position, finger movement, key resistance, and pedals add skills that a touchscreen cannot reproduce. Use a virtual keyboard to explore notes, then practise those movements on an instrument when available.

sections.heading: Keep the next practice session simple
paragraphs: In Melody Garden, select piano and your learning age range, then choose a suitable lesson. On-screen practice does not require microphone permission. Optional microphone practice analyzes sound locally for pitch feedback without saving or uploading audio.

Finish by noting which pattern needs another attempt. The app keeps results and preferences locally, so avoid resetting progress or uninstalling if you want to retain them. Check current download access on the app page before planning around a new installation.

faq: Can I learn piano without owning a piano?
You can begin learning note locations and simple patterns on a virtual keyboard. Physical playing technique still needs practice on an instrument.
Can I play piano in my browser on this website?
A Wonderworld Labs web version is planned. This page is a beginner guide, not a playable keyboard. The current Melody Garden product is an Android app.
Does Melody Garden also help me learn guitar?
Yes, the current Android app supports guitar learning and an optional microphone-based tuner. Guitar fingering and string technique require a physical guitar.

name: Arrow unleashed
title: Arrow puzzle hints: turn a stuck moment into useful practice
description: Use a deliberate routine when an arrow puzzle feels difficult: inspect the board, make a prediction, use a hint thoughtfully, and protect local progress.
answer: Before using an arrow puzzle hint, pause and decide what you are unsure about. Read the current puzzle instructions, inspect one candidate move, and predict its result. If you use a hint, compare it with your prediction before continuing. Arrow unleashed stores hints, lives, and progress locally; this guide does not promise unlimited hints or a universal answer.

sections.heading: Check which puzzle you are playing
paragraphs: Searches for arrow puzzles can lead to sliding-arrow games, arrow-word crosswords, or direction puzzles. Their rules and answers are different. Match help to the game and board in front of you rather than applying a solution just because its title contains the word arrow.

In Arrow unleashed, use the instructions and feedback in your installed version. A screenshot of another game or a different board is not reliable evidence for the next move. This guide is a general practice routine, not a level-by-level solution.

sections.heading: Use a pause, predict, check routine
paragraphs: When the board looks crowded, reduce the decision to one candidate. Explain to yourself why you think it will work before tapping. The purpose is to make your reasoning visible, so you can change it when the result differs.
steps: Pause rather than repeating the same uncertain move.
Re-read the current objective and any relevant instructions.
Inspect one candidate and predict what the game will do.
Make the move only when you are ready to compare the result with that prediction.
After feedback, review what you missed before choosing again.

sections.heading: Make one hint worth more than one answer
paragraphs: If a hint is available, first identify the part you cannot resolve. After using it, look back at that uncertainty and explain what the hint helped you notice. On the next comparable decision, try the reasoning yourself before requesting another hint.

Arrow unleashed saves remaining lives and hints on the device. The privacy policy does not specify how hints are earned or replenished, so this guide does not promise an allowance, refill time, or reward method. Check the current game interface for the options actually offered.

sections.heading: Finish without losing your progress
paragraphs: A short session can end with one useful observation rather than a completed board. Arrow unleashed keeps puzzle progress, daily completions, settings, XP, badges, and goals locally. It has no developer game server or account that restores your play history.

Clearing Android app storage or uninstalling removes local records. Restarting one puzzle is different from erasing all app data; do not use system storage controls as a way to obtain more hints. The current game has no advertising or in-app purchases.

faq: Does this guide give the answer to every arrow puzzle?
No. Boards and rules vary. It gives a repeatable way to examine a decision and learn from feedback.
Are hints unlimited in Arrow unleashed?
No unlimited-hint claim is made. Hints are recorded locally; use the options shown by your installed version.
Do I need an internet connection to keep my milestones?
The current game stores milestones on-device and does not request internet permission. Local storage is not cloud backup.

name: The Whispering Diary
title: Offline AI chat setup: what to check before downloading the model
description: Prepare for The Whispering Diary’s model download, understand the connection used during setup, and check local conversations before going offline.
answer: The Whispering Diary needs a one-time model download of approximately 805 MB before ordinary AI conversations can run offline. Use a stable connection and sufficient free storage, allow the app to check the downloaded file, and try a short conversation before relying on it without internet. Downloading a model is separate from uploading your diary: diary entries are not included in the download request.

sections.heading: Why an offline chat app needs an initial download
paragraphs: A local AI model is the file the app uses to generate replies on your phone. The Whispering Diary downloads its Qwen model directly from Hugging Face over HTTPS and checks the file before use. The download service can process technical request details such as your IP address, file requested, and time.

After setup, ordinary conversations run locally. This distinction matters when comparing offline AI chat apps: ask which stage needs a connection and which information travels over it, rather than assuming offline means no network request ever.

sections.heading: Prepare storage and a connection
paragraphs: The approximately 805 MB figure is the model file, not a promise that the whole app fits within that space. Leave additional room for the installed app, conversations, and normal device operation. Exact free-space requirements and generation speed depend on the app and device; this guide does not give an unverified RAM or speed guarantee.
steps: Check available device storage before beginning.
Use a connection suitable for a large download and check any mobile-data limits.
Follow the app’s setup prompts and let its file check finish.
Try a short, non-sensitive conversation while setup is complete.
Disconnect from the network and confirm that an ordinary conversation works on your installed version.

sections.heading: If setup does not complete
paragraphs: Read the error shown by the app before retrying. Check the connection and free storage first. A failed download is not proof that you must erase conversations or reinstall the app. If the error persists, contact support with the error text and device details, avoiding private diary entries.

Do not substitute a random model file merely because it has a similar name. Compatibility and file checks matter. This guide does not promise resumable downloads, manual model import, or support for arbitrary models.

sections.heading: Understand what remains on your phone
paragraphs: Conversations, drafts, approved memories, preferences, and response flags are stored privately on the device and excluded from automatic Android cloud backup. Optional diary lock uses Android biometric or screen-lock controls; the app does not receive your fingerprint or device PIN.

Removing the downloaded model preserves conversations, but the model is needed to generate ordinary local replies. Uninstalling removes local app data. Export anything you want to keep before uninstalling, and consider the storage practices of the export destination. Elias is a fictional character for adults; replies can be inaccurate and are not professional or emergency advice.

faq: Are my diary entries sent during the model download?
No. The model download request does not include diary entries. Hugging Face may process technical information needed to deliver the file.
Does removing the model delete conversations?
The current app preserves conversations when you remove the downloaded model. Uninstalling is different and removes local app data.
Can I use the app for emergency or professional advice?
No. The Whispering Diary is adult fictional entertainment. Its small local model can generate inaccurate responses.

name: Melody Garden
title: Learn guitar: string names and a simple first practice session
description: Start learning guitar with standard string names, a tuning check, and a short single-string exercise. Compare physical practice, Android lessons, and online tools.
answer: Start with a tuned six-string guitar and learn its open-string notes: E, A, D, G, B, E, from thickest to thinnest in standard tuning. Practise making one clear note before trying a whole song. Melody Garden offers offline Android guitar lessons and an optional microphone tuner; a virtual guitar cannot reproduce fretting and strumming a physical instrument.

sections.heading: Know which string you are playing
paragraphs: In standard tuning, string 6 is the thick, low E; string 1 is the thin, high E. Between them are A, D, G, and B. An open string is played without pressing a fret. Name a string before plucking it so that the note name becomes connected to its location.

This guide is for a standard six-string guitar. Other instruments and alternate tunings need different notes. If you are unsure how to tune your instrument, use its instructions or ask a teacher rather than repeatedly tightening a string that does not sound right.

sections.heading: Tune before comparing your notes
paragraphs: Use a tuner suited to your instrument and follow its instructions one string at a time. Melody Garden includes an optional microphone-based guitar tuner. It analyzes live sound on your device without saving or uploading microphone audio. On-screen practice remains available if you do not grant microphone access.

Choose a quiet place and let one string sound clearly before moving to another. If detection is inconsistent, reduce competing sound and check microphone permission. Do not assume an unclear reading means that the string needs a large adjustment.

sections.heading: Try a short open-string exercise
steps: Choose one comfortable open string and identify its name.
Pluck it once, let the sound settle, and repeat with a light, controlled movement.
Count four steady beats and try one pluck on each beat. Start slowly enough to stay consistent.
Move to a neighbouring string and repeat, saying its name before playing.
Finish by returning to the first string without looking at a note list.
paragraphs: This is a suggested beginner exercise, not a named app mode. Focus on a clear sound and an even gap between notes. Chords and complete songs can wait until selecting a string and keeping a slow pulse feel less unfamiliar.

sections.heading: Use an app or online lesson with a clear goal
paragraphs: In Melody Garden, choose guitar and the appropriate learning age range, then start a suitable lesson. Keep your first goal small: recognizing string names, following an on-screen exercise, or using the tuner. Local results and favorites can help you return to the same material.

Learning guitar online can mean watching instruction, reading a chord diagram, or using a virtual instrument. These are different activities. Check that the resource teaches the skill you want, and distinguish a computer keyboard shortcut from a real fret or string. Wonderworld Labs plans a web version; no browser guitar player, release date, pricing, or song catalogue is promised here.

sections.heading: Build towards playing a song
paragraphs: Choose a short beginner arrangement from a lawful source. Identify the tuning and the notes or chords it requires before starting. Work on a small phrase slowly, then connect it to the next phrase. A physical guitar is needed to develop pressure, finger placement, and strumming control.

Keep practice comfortable, take breaks, and avoid forcing a difficult movement. An app can guide repetition, but it cannot inspect your posture or replace individual feedback. Check the app page for current download access before relying on a new installation.

faq: What are the standard guitar string names?
From thickest to thinnest: E, A, D, G, B, E. The thickest string is number 6; the thinnest is number 1.
Can I learn guitar without allowing the microphone?
Melody Garden supports on-screen practice without microphone permission. Its optional tuner and microphone practice need that permission.
Can I play guitar online on this website?
The Wonderworld Labs web version is planned. The current Melody Garden app is for Android; this guide is not a playable browser instrument.
